item.content:encoded: La policía antidisturbios albanesa utilizó gases lacrimógenos, cañones de agua y balas de goma para dispersar el sábado a los manifestantes que lanzaron piedras contra los agentes y provocaron un incendio en la puerta del Ministerio de Agricultura en la capital. Las manifestaciones lideradas por estudiantes, avivadas por la indignación ante la supuesta corrupción del Gobierno, la falta de empleo y el bajo nivel educativo, han invadido el centro de Tirana y se han extendido a otras ciudades este mes. Los manifestantes, que exigen la dimisión del primer ministro Edi Rama, han incendiado edificios gubernamentales y bancos, han destrozado escaparates y han arrancado adoquines para lanzárselos a la policía. Los disturbios, que se producen tras meses de protestas en su mayoría pacíficas contra un lujoso proyecto urbanístico costero respaldado por el yerno de Donald Trump, Jared Kushner, suponen el mayor desafío hasta la fecha para Rama, que gobierna desde 2013 y ganó un cuarto mandato el año pasado. Los manifestantes se reunieron frente al Ministerio de Educación y lanzaron piedras y rocas contra la policía, que los hizo retroceder y dispersarse por varios puntos de la ciudad.

item.title: Reports: Michigan State QB Milivojevic out vs. No. 9 UCLA
item.description: Michigan State quarterback Alessio Milivojevic was ruled out of Saturday's road game against No. 9 UCLA with an undisclosed injury, multiple outlets reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Michigan State quarterback Alessio Milivojevic was ruled out of Saturday's road game against No. 9 UCLA with an undisclosed injury, multiple outlets reported. The injury leaves true freshman Kayd Coffman to start for the Spartans (2-5, 0-4 Big Ten), with backup QB Cam Fancher also out with an injury. Coffman has appeared in one game this season, seeing mop-up duty in a 31-3 loss to Wisconsin on Oct. 3 when Fancher was injured. He did not attempt a pass in his brief appearance. Milivojevic had been listed as questionable to play earlier this week as Michigan State rides a five-game losing streak heading into Saturday's game at Pasadena, Calif. In seven games this season, Milivojevic has completed 65.4% of his passes for 1,263 yards, seven touchdowns and three interceptions. UCLA (6-0, 4-0) knows all about quarterback injuries. The Bruins lost starter Nico Iamaleava to a knee injury during an Oct. 10 victory at Oregon. Cal Poly transfer Ty Dieffenbach took over and finished off the victory over the Ducks then led the Bruins to a 17-7 victory over Wisconsin last week in his first career FBS start. --Field Level Media

item.title: Magic star Paolo Banchero sustains low-grade high-ankle sprain
item.description: Orlando Magic star forward Paolo Banchero is nursing a low-grade high-ankle sprain, the team announced Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Orlando Magic star forward Paolo Banchero is nursing a low-grade high-ankle sprain, the team announced Saturday. The Magic did not disclose a recovery timetable, with ESPN reporting the injury diagnosis typically carries a timetable of four-to-six weeks. Banchero sustained the injury during the third quarter of the Magic's 115-93 loss to the Minnesota Timberwolves on Friday. "Most of all my ankle sprains have always been to the outside, so this is kind of foreign to me," Banchero told the Orlando Sentinel. "So a little scary in that way." Banchero, 23, has averaged 24.5 points, 7.5 assists and 6.5 rebounds in two games (both starts) this season. The former No. 1 overall draft pick in 2022 has averaged 22.4 points, 7.4 rebounds and 4.8 assists in 272 games (all starts) in five seasons for Orlando. --Field Level Media

item.title: Hutíes afirman haber atacado instalaciones petroleras saudíes, se registran ataques en Yemen
item.description: Los hutíes de Yemen afirmaron el sábado que lanzaron ataques contra instalaciones petroleras y aeropuertos de Arabia Saudita, mientras que la coalición liderada por el reino que combate al grupo dijo haber derribado dos misiles mientras se intensifican los enfrentamientos entre ambas partes.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Los hutíes de Yemen afirmaron el sábado que lanzaron ataques contra instalaciones petroleras y aeropuertos de Arabia Saudita, mientras que la coalición liderada por el reino que combate al grupo dijo haber derribado dos misiles mientras se intensifican los enfrentamientos entre ambas partes. En otro frente de un conflicto cada vez más intenso, reavivado por la guerra con Irán, el Gobierno yemení respaldado por Riad afirmó que los hutíes también lanzaron tres misiles balísticos contra instalaciones de la guardia costera en la ciudad portuaria de Adén, al sur de Yemen. Las autoridades sauditas no confirmaron de inmediato las informaciones de los hutíes, y no quedó claro si los supuestos ataques habían alcanzado sus objetivos en el reino o habían sido interceptados. El portavoz militar hutí, Yahya Saree, afirmó que el grupo había atacado el Aeropuerto Internacional Rey Khalid de Riad, una instalación de Aramco en Yanbu, la refinería de petróleo de Rabigh, estaciones de bombeo de crudo y el oleoducto Este-Oeste. También señaló que el grupo había atacado el Aeropuerto Internacional Rey Fahd de Dammam, un aeropuerto en Najran y una base aérea en Khamis Mushait. La coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita afirmó haber destruido el sábado dos misiles balísticos lanzados por los hutíes hacia Yanbu y Taif. La reanudación de los combates ha hecho añicos la tregua de 2022 negociada por la ONU, que había frenado en gran medida los ataques transfronterizos entre la coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita y los hutíes, que controlan la capital, Saná. La escalada ha abierto otro frente en la guerra de Estados Unidos e Israel contra Irán. En Yemen, el Ministerio del Interior del Gobierno reconocido internacionalmente afirmó que dos de los misiles de los hutíes habían impactado en una sede de la guardia costera, mientras que un tercero alcanzó un edificio de la guardia costera en el distrito de Tawahi. El portavoz hutí, Saree, afirmó que el grupo había atacado concentraciones militares respaldadas por Arabia Saudita en lo que denominó el campamento de Al-Nasr y una base naval en Adén, y señaló que oficiales sauditas supervisaban la movilización en esos lugares. La coalición no hizo ningún comentario sobre esa afirmación.

item.title: Irán ha intensificado esfuerzos para atacar a personal EEUU, advierte reporte de servicios inteligencia
item.description: Irán ha intensificado sus esfuerzos para atacar al personal estadounidense, y los complots letales de la república islámica contra sus ciudadanos han alcanzado "fases avanzadas", advirtió un alto cargo de los servicios de inteligencia de Washington en un memorándum al que Reuters tuvo acceso.
item.dc:creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Enas Alashray
item.content:encoded: Irán ha intensificado sus esfuerzos para atacar al personal estadounidense, y los complots letales de la república islámica contra sus ciudadanos han alcanzado "fases avanzadas", advirtió un alto cargo de los servicios de inteligencia de Washington en un memorándum al que Reuters tuvo acceso. La alerta del director de Inteligencia Nacional, Jay Clayton, se produjo después de que Washington redujera a principios de esta semana la plantilla de su misión en Arabia Saudita, en respuesta a la intensificación de los ataques por parte de las fuerzas hutíes, aliadas de Irán. Esos ataques en uno de los frentes del conflicto regional, que dura ya casi ocho meses y que se desencadenó a raíz de la Guerra de Irán, han coincidido con un aumento de los ataques contra el transporte marítimo comercial en el estrecho de Ormuz. A principios de este mes, fuentes informaron a Reuters que Irán estaba preparando una respuesta más contundente en caso de que Estados Unidos reanudara los ataques militares a gran escala contra su territorio. "Concretamente, a través de diversos canales, hemos recibido información de inteligencia según la cual Irán ha intensificado considerablemente sus esfuerzos para atacar al personal estadounidense", escribió Clayton al secretario de Estado Marco Rubio en un mensaje fechado el 23 de octubre. "Los planes letales de los iraníes contra ciudadanos estadounidenses han alcanzado fases avanzadas tanto en Oriente Medio como en algunos otros países", añadió. El Departamento de Estado ordenó el miércoles a los empleados públicos no esenciales y a sus familiares que abandonaran las misiones diplomáticas de EEUU en Arabia Saudita y tenía previsto retirar a los familiares de otras misiones de la región, informaron fuentes de Washington a Reuters. El Departamento de Estado actualizó el sábado las advertencias de viaje para más de una docena de países del Golfo y Oriente Medio, entre ellos Arabia Saudita, Qatar, los Emiratos Árabes Unidos, Irak e Israel, alegando una mayor amenaza por parte de los hutíes. "La amenaza de ataques hutíes y de complots terroristas iraníes dirigidos contra funcionarios estadounidenses está determinando nuestras decisiones sobre los ajustes de personal en las embajadas que se encuentran en 'estado de operaciones restringidas' (ROE) en la región", dijo un funcionario estadounidense. El ROE proporciona al Departamento de Estado mayor flexibilidad en las decisiones relativas al personal sin tener que anunciar públicamente un cambio en el estatus de una misión.

item.title: Nigeria's Tinubu launches re-election campaign as economic pain tests support
item.description: President Bola Tinubu formally launched his campaign for a second term on Saturday in the northern city of Kaduna, where he sought to convince voters that painful economic reforms are beginning to pay off despite a lingering cost-of-living crisis.
item.dc:creator: Camillus Eboh, Ben Ezeamalu
item.content:encoded: President Bola Tinubu formally launched his campaign for a second term on Saturday in the northern city of Kaduna, where he sought to convince voters that painful economic reforms are beginning to pay off despite a lingering cost-of-living crisis. Tinubu, 74, faces a contest ahead of a January 16 election that is likely to be dominated by the economy and security. His main challengers include former Vice President Atiku Abubakar and Peter Obi, who finished second and third respectively in 2023. By midday, thousands of supporters of the president's All Progressives Congress party had filled much of the 10,000-capacity Ranchers Bees Stadium, with more arriving as the rally got underway. "Thank you for this massive showing up. It is a promise. Come 2027, January 16, you must go out massively and elect me again," Tinubu told the crowd. OPPOSITION CREATED PROBLEMS, SAYS TINUBU Since taking office in 2023, Tinubu has scrapped [USN:S8N36204O TEXT:"fuel subsidies"], devalued the [USN:S8N362046 TEXT:"naira"] and introduced other reforms credited with improving public finances, foreign reserves and investor sentiment. But the measures have also fuelled Nigeria's worst cost-of-living crisis in a generation. Petrol prices rose to about 1,400 naira ($1.05) a litre in Lagos and Abuja in September and as much as 1,500 naira in parts of northern Nigeria, adding to pressure on household budgets. Tinubu dismissed opposition complaints about hunger and poverty, arguing that his rivals created those problems. "They created the hunger. They created the poverty. We are trying to eradicate it." Phrank Shaibu, a spokesperson for the Atiku campaign, told Reuters the president was attempting to dodge responsibility. "Mr President, blaming the opposition for hunger is either delusion or a staggering case of political amnesia," he said. Security will provide [USN:L6N44N0Z4 TEXT:"another test"]. Nigeria continues to battle armed bandits and kidnappers in the northwest and a 17-year Islamist insurgency in the northeast, where militants have stepped up attacks on military positions. Tinubu nevertheless enters the race with a formidable political machine. His camp says he has the backing of 32 of Nigeria's 36 state governors, potentially giving him an unprecedented organisational advantage, although past elections have shown governors cannot always deliver their states to presidential candidates. His toughest electoral test could come in [USN:L6N434151 TEXT:"the north"], where Atiku, a veteran northern politician with an established support base, will seek to erode the president's vote. Tinubu has said he will not attend campaign rallies in all 36 states as he needs to remain focused on governing. The party's proposed timetable has him personally attending rallies in 12 states, culminating in a major closing rally in his home state of Lagos on January 9. ($1 = 1,330.6400 naira)

item.title: Incêndio devasta antigo refúgio nazista "Ninho da Águia"
item.description: Bombeiros trabalharam por horas para conter um incêndio que atingiu o refúgio nazista conhecido como "Ninho da Águia", no sul da Alemanha, enquanto a polícia investigava a causa do fogo após deter um homem nas proximidades do local, informaram as autoridades neste sábado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Bombeiros trabalharam por horas para conter um incêndio que atingiu o refúgio nazista conhecido como "Ninho da Águia", no sul da Alemanha, enquanto a polícia investigava a causa do fogo após deter um homem nas proximidades do local, informaram as autoridades neste sábado. Cerca de 200 bombeiros e equipes de emergência na região de Berchtesgaden, no Estado da Baviera, combatiam as chamas após o edifício, conhecido como Kehlsteinhaus, pegar fogo na sexta-feira, segundo a polícia. Construído em 1938 como casa de hóspedes para autoridades nazistas e seus convidados, o prédio está situado em um cenário alpino de destaque acima de Berchtesgaden. Adolf Hitler o utilizava ocasionalmente, o que lhe rendeu o apelido de "Casa de Chá de Hitler". O imóvel é separado da residência de verão de Hitler nas proximidades, o Berghof. O jornal Bild citou um porta-voz da polícia dizendo que o edifício, preservado após a Segunda Guerra Mundial como monumento histórico ligado ao período nazista, sofreu danos tão graves que "provavelmente não poderá ser salvo". A polícia informou anteriormente que havia detido um homem próximo ao local, mas ainda não havia determinado a causa do incêndio. "A possibilidade de essa pessoa estar ligada ao incêndio é atualmente objeto de uma investigação criminal", informou a polícia da Baviera em comunicado. (Reportagem de James Mackenzie)

item.title: Gabriel shines at both ends as Arsenal ease past Everton to go level with Man City
item.description: Gabriel Magalhaes proved Arsenal's hero at both ends of the pitch on Saturday as the reigning champions beat Everton 2-0 to draw level with Manchester City at the Premier League summit.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Gabriel Magalhaes proved Arsenal's hero at both ends of the pitch on Saturday as the reigning champions beat Everton 2-0 to draw level with Manchester City at the Premier League summit. Making his 200th Premier League appearance, the centre back was instrumental in a victory that [USN:L2N46A02I TEXT:"put Arsenal level on 21 points with City"], the Brazilian combining defensive authority at the back with a decisive goal that put the result beyond doubt. "He's one of the best centre backs in the world, no question, with the impact he has in both boxes," Arsenal boss Mikel Arteta said. "His leadership, his presence, what he offers to the rest of the boys is unique and we're very happy to have him." With his regular partner William Saliba still absent through injury, Gabriel's importance to Arsenal was underlined when Everton struggled to establish a foothold in the pouring rain at Emirates Stadium. Gabriel consistently got the better of Everton striker Thierno Barry, who had a frustrating afternoon repeatedly ending up on the slick turf and pounding the ground in frustration after losing several duels with the defender. Gabriel also came to Arsenal's rescue when goalkeeper David Raya failed to deal convincingly with an Everton corner in the first half, clearing the danger off the line to preserve the north London side's advantage. There was a brief injury scare after an awkward landing when Gabriel jarred his knee on the turf, but he quickly returned to score the decisive second goal in the 68th minute. After his centre back partner Ezri Konsa had opened the scoring from a corner in the seventh minute -- Arsenal's first set-piece goal since May -- Gabriel rose at the back post to meet Ben White's floated cross to head home their second. "Gabi was unbelievable, the action that leads to the possible injury and then the way he overcomes that situation with his willingness to go again and to score that goal," Arteta added. "It's a great description of what he is as a player and as a leader in this club." It was Gabriel's 21st Premier League goal for Arsenal - more than any other defender since he made his debut in the competition six years ago. "Very pleased for him. He's a top, top player. Top human being. Very happy for him," Konsa said. "He's made my life easy since I've joined the club and it's been a pleasure playing alongside him."

item.title: Browns activate RB Dylan Sampson from IR
item.description: The Cleveland Browns activated running back Dylan Sampson off injured reserve Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Cleveland Browns activated running back Dylan Sampson off injured reserve Saturday. Sampson, who was placed on IR Sept. 15 with a knee injury, will not have an injury status for the Browns (4-2) in their game against the host Tennessee Titans (1-5) on Sunday in Nashville, Tenn. Sampson, 22, was hurt returning a kickoff in the first quarter of Cleveland's 34-10 loss to the host Jacksonville Jaguars on Sept. 13. He rushed 65 times for 175 yards and added 33 catches for 271 yards and two touchdowns in 15 games (two starts) during his rookie season last year. Sampson was selected by Cleveland in the fourth round of the 2025 NFL Draft out of University of Tennessee. Also on Saturday, the Browns announced safety Grant Delpit has cleared concussion protocol and has no injury status for Sunday's game. The team also placed guard Teven Jenkins (back) on injured reserve and elevated defensive tackle Sam Kamara from the practice squad. --Field Level Media

item.title: Houthis dizem ter atacado instalações petrolíferas e aeroportos sauditas; coalizão afirma ter interceptado mísseis
item.description: Os houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, disseram que atacaram instalações petrolíferas e aeroportos da Arábia Saudita neste sábado, enquanto a coalizão liderada pelos sauditas que combate o grupo afirmou ter interceptado dois mísseis, à medida que os confrontos entre os dois lados se intensificam.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Os houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, disseram que atacaram instalações petrolíferas e aeroportos da Arábia Saudita neste sábado, enquanto a coalizão liderada pelos sauditas que combate o grupo afirmou ter interceptado dois mísseis, à medida que os confrontos entre os dois lados se intensificam. Em outra frente do conflito em escalada reavivado pela guerra envolvendo o Irã, o governo iemenita apoiado pela Arábia Saudita informou que os houthis também dispararam três mísseis balísticos contra instalações da guarda costeira na cidade portuária de Áden, no sul do país, sem relatos de vítimas. Não houve confirmação imediata por parte das autoridades sauditas sobre os relatos, e não estava claro se os ataques reportados atingiram seus alvos no reino ou se foram interceptados. O porta-voz militar houthi, Yahya Saree, afirmou que o grupo teve como alvo o Aeroporto Internacional Rei Khalid, em Riad, uma instalação da Aramco em Yanbu, a refinaria de petróleo de Rabigh, estações de bombeamento de petróleo bruto e o oleoduto East-West. Ele também disse que o grupo atacou o Aeroporto Internacional Rei Fahd, em Dammam, um aeroporto em Najran e uma base aérea em Khamis Mushait. Mais cedo neste sábado, a Defesa Civil da Arábia Saudita emitiu brevemente alertas advertindo moradores sobre um possível perigo em Taif e Yanbu, bem como na cidade sagrada de Meca e em Jeddah, a segunda maior cidade do reino. Cerca de dez minutos depois, o órgão informou que a ameaça havia passado. As interceptações ocorreram dois dias após os houthis afirmarem ter atacado o Ministério da Defesa saudita, em Riad, instalações da gigante petrolífera Saudi Aramco na cidade de Yanbu, às margens do Mar Vermelho, e o Aeroporto Internacional Rei Fahd, em Dammam, onde autoridades sauditas disseram que duas pessoas morreram. A Aramco orientou funcionários a evacuarem sua sede na cidade de Dhahran, no Golfo, disseram à Reuters, na quinta-feira, seis fontes com conhecimento do assunto. A coalizão liderada pela Arábia Saudita informou na quinta-feira que interceptou drones sobre Riad e Medina, não muito longe de Yanbu. Na quarta-feira, os houthis negaram ter lançado drones em direção a Medina, após a coalizão afirmar que havia interceptado aeronaves não tripuladas sobre a cidade sagrada e sobre a Região Oriental da Arábia Saudita. No Iêmen, o Ministério do Interior do governo internacionalmente reconhecido informou que os houthis dispararam três mísseis balísticos contra instalações da guarda costeira em Áden neste sábado. Dois mísseis atingiram o quartel-general da guarda costeira no complexo do ministério, enquanto um terceiro atingiu um edifício da guarda costeira no distrito de Tawahi, segundo o ministério. Em comunicado separado, Saree afirmou que as forças houthis atacaram concentrações de tropas apoiadas pela Arábia Saudita no que chamou de Campo Al-Nasr e em uma base naval militar em Áden, alegando que oficiais sauditas supervisionavam a mobilização no local. A coalizão liderada pelos sauditas não comentou imediatamente a declaração. Os houthis advertiram companhias aéreas no início deste mês a não utilizarem o espaço aéreo saudita, excetuando apenas o espaço aéreo sobre Meca e Medina, à medida que aumentavam os ataques contra o reino. A retomada dos combates destruiu a trégua mediada pela ONU em 2022, que havia interrompido em grande medida os ataques transfronteiriços entre a coalizão liderada pela Arábia Saudita, que apoia o governo internacionalmente reconhecido do Iêmen, e os houthis, que controlam a capital Sanaa. A escalada abriu mais uma frente na guerra entre Estados Unidos e Israel contra o Irã. (Reportagem de Yasmine Ghania e Eman Abouhassira)

item.title: Eagles WRs DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks not spotted at practice
item.description: The Philadelphia Eagles could be without star DeVonta Smith and fellow wide receiver Dontayvion Wicks for Monday's home game against the rival Dallas Cowboys.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Philadelphia Eagles could be without star DeVonta Smith and fellow wide receiver Dontayvion Wicks for Monday's home game against the rival Dallas Cowboys. Smith (hamstring) and Wicks (ankle) were not spotted at the portion of practice open to the media on Saturday, but tight end Dallas Goedert (knee) was on the field. All three players did not participate in practice on Thursday or Friday. Smith returned from a two-game absence last Sunday to record seven catches for 75 yards and a touchdown in Philadelphia's 25-14 loss to the Carolina Panthers. He leads the team in both receptions (26) and receiving yards (310). He also has two touchdown catches in four games this season. Wicks is second on the team in receptions (19) and receiving yards (284). He has one touchdown catch in six games this season. Makai Lemon, Darius Cooper, Marquise "Hollywood" Brown, Elijah Moore and Britain Covey are the other receivers for the Eagles (2-4), who have lost four games in a row. Tight end Zach Ertz is out of practice-squad elevations but could be signed to the active roster should Goedert be unable to play on Monday. Goedert has 17 catches for 180 yards and two touchdowns this season. --Field Level Media

item.title: Environ 1.200 Palestiniens déplacés à Hébron par une opération militaire israélienne
item.description: L'armée israélienne a contraint environ 1.200 Palestiniens à quitter leurs foyers à Hébron, en Cisjordanie occupée, a déclaré samedi un responsable palestinien, au lendemain d'une attaque qui a coûté la vie à deux soldats israéliens.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: L'armée israélienne a contraint environ 1.200 Palestiniens à quitter leurs foyers à Hébron, en Cisjordanie occupée, a déclaré samedi un responsable palestinien, au lendemain d'une attaque qui a coûté la vie à deux soldats israéliens. Le Premier ministre israélien Benjamin Netanyahu avait déclaré vendredi que l'armée lancerait une opération de grande envergure après la mort des soldats, tués lorsque deux Palestiniens ont ouvert le feu sur un poste de contrôle militaire près de la ville. Les deux assaillants ont été abattus. L'armée a dit mener une opération dans deux quartiers qui jouxtent le poste de contrôle attaqué vendredi à la recherche de suspects et d'armes et pour y procéder à des destructions de bâtiments. L'Autorité palestinienne a critiqué cette opération, la qualifiant de "punition collective". Youssef Zouhair al Jabari, le maire de Hébron, a déclaré qu'environ 1.300 personnes risquaient de perdre leur logement, en plus des 1.200 déjà déplacées. Il a ajouté que ces opérations israéliennes étaient motivées par les élections législatives de mardi, lors desquelles la coalition de droite de Benjamin Netanyahu pourrait perdre sa majorité, selon les sondages d'intention de vote. "Netanyahu et les ministres extrémistes de son gouvernement tentent de remporter le plus grand nombre possible de voix parmi les colons", a-t-il dit. Des habitants de Hébron ont déclaré à Reuters que l’armée avait expulsé de nombreuses personnes n’ayant aucun lien avec les assaillants palestiniens. "Nous appelons les autorités à nous soutenir, car nous ne sommes impliqués dans rien de tout cela. Il y a des enfants. Nous sommes isolés ; nous ne faisons rien. Tout cela est arbitraire", a déclaré Majdi Nasser, l’un des habitants chassés de son domicile. Dans toute la Cisjordanie, Israël a bloqué les accès à la plupart des villes et villages palestiniens, restreignant considérablement la liberté de circulation des habitants.

item.title: Steelers activate S DeShon Elliott from injured reserve
item.description: Pittsburgh Steelers safety DeShon Elliott returned to the active roster for the first time in 12 months on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Pittsburgh Steelers safety DeShon Elliott returned to the active roster for the first time in 12 months on Saturday. Elliott, 29, was activated from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game in Paris against the New Orleans Saints. Elliott is returning from a season-ending knee injury sustained in a Week 8 loss to Green Bay on Oct. 26, 2025. He returned to practice on Oct. 8, opening a 21-day window either to return to the 53-man roster or miss the entire season. A sixth-round draft pick by Baltimore in 2018, Elliott has recorded 433 tackles, 4.5 sacks, five interceptions and five fumble recoveries in 77 games (69 starts) with the Ravens (2019-21), Detroit Lions (2022), Miami Dolphins (2023) and Steelers. The Steelers (4-2) also elevated wide receivers Brandon Johnson and Brandon Smith from the practice squad to the active roster for the game against the Saints (2-4). --Field Level Media

item.title: Penguins place D Samuel Girard on injured reserve
item.description: The Pittsburgh Penguins placed veteran defenseman Samuel Girard on injured reserve Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Pittsburgh Penguins placed veteran defenseman Samuel Girard on injured reserve Saturday. Girard, 28, sustained a lower-body injury during a 6-2 road loss to the Vegas Golden Knights on Oct. 17. He has one goal and six assists through nine games in his first full season with the Penguins, who acquired him in a Feb. 24 trade with the Colorado Avalanche. A 2022 Stanley Cup champion with Colorado, Girard has posted 249 points (38 goals, 211 assists) in 617 games with the Nashville Predators, Avalanche and Penguins. Pittsburgh recalled forward Avery Hayes, 24, from AHL affiliate Wilkes-Barre/Scranton in a corresponding transaction. He made his NHL debut with the Penguins last season and tallied five goals in 16 games. --Field Level Media

item.title: Albanian police fire tear gas as anti-government student protests turn violent
item.description: Albanian riot police used tear gas, water cannons and rubber bullets to disperse protesters who threw rocks at officers and started a fire at the door of the agriculture ministry in the capital, Tirana, on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Albanian riot police used tear gas, water cannons and rubber bullets to disperse protesters who threw rocks at officers and started a fire at the door of the agriculture ministry in the capital, Tirana, on Saturday. Student-led demonstrations, fuelled by anger over perceived government corruption, a lack of jobs and poor education standards, have engulfed central Tirana and spread to other cities this month. Demonstrators demanding the resignation of Prime Minister Edi Rama have set fire to government buildings as well as banks, smashed shop windows and pulled up paving stones to throw at police. The unrest, which followed months of largely peaceful summer protests [USN:L6N42J18T TEXT:"against a luxury coastal development"] backed by US President Donald Trump's son-in-law Jared Kushner, poses the biggest challenge yet to Rama, who has governed since 2013 and won a fourth term in office last year. The protesters gathered on Saturday around 2 p.m. (1200 GMT) in front of the education ministry, and threw stones and rocks at police. The police pushed them away and they dispersed to several locations in the city. "Albanians have woken up," said 28-year-old protester Daniel Tahiri, who described the government as a "dictatorship with the clothes of democracy." Another protester, 29-year-old Orgeta Likaj, said people wanted Rama to know that Albanians no longer want him because of corruption and scandals.

item.title: Cerca de 1.200 palestinos são deslocados em Hebron com início de operação militar israelense
item.description: O exército israelense obrigou cerca de 1.200 palestinos a deixarem suas casas em Hebron, na Cisjordânia ocupada, informou uma autoridade palestina neste sábado, um dia após um ataque palestino matar dois soldados israelenses.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O exército israelense obrigou cerca de 1.200 palestinos a deixarem suas casas em Hebron, na Cisjordânia ocupada, informou uma autoridade palestina neste sábado, um dia após um ataque palestino matar dois soldados israelenses. O primeiro-ministro de Israel, Benjamin Netanyahu, havia anunciado na sexta-feira que os militares lançariam uma operação de grande escala após a morte dos soldados, atingidos quando dois homens armados palestinos abriram fogo contra um posto de controle militar próximo à cidade. O Exército israelense informou que os atiradores foram mortos. Os militares também afirmaram que a operação nos bairros de Al-Jaladah e Ein Deir Baha, próximos ao posto de controle na entrada de Hebron, tinha como objetivo procurar militantes e armas. Em comunicado, disseram ainda que realizariam demolições. A Autoridade Palestina criticou a operação, classificando-a como uma “punição coletiva”. Yousef Zouhair Al-Jabari, chefe da prefeitura de Hebron, disse que cerca de 1.300 pessoas corriam o risco de perder suas casas, além das 1.200 já deslocadas. Ele afirmou ainda que as operações israelenses foram motivadas pelas eleições parlamentares de terça-feira, nas quais a coalizão de direita de Netanyahu pode perder sua maioria, segundo pesquisas de opinião. “Netanyahu e os ministros radicais de seu governo estão tentando conquistar o maior número possível de votos dos colonos”, disse Al-Jabari. A organização não governamental Clube dos Prisioneiros Palestinos informou que as forças israelenses prenderam cerca de 70 palestinos na sexta-feira e no sábado. Autoridades israelenses não comentaram as supostas detenções. ASSENTAMENTOS Al-Jabari afirmou que os militares demoliram lojas, fábricas, residências e estradas em Hebron e que a resposta foi desproporcional e injustificada. Moradores de Hebron disseram à Reuters que os militares expulsaram muitas pessoas sem qualquer ligação com os autores do ataque palestino. “Estamos pedindo às autoridades que nos apoiem porque não temos envolvimento algum com isso. Há crianças. Estamos isolados; não fazemos nada. Tudo isso é arbitrário”, disse Majdi Nasser, um dos moradores retirados de sua casa. Moradores relataram à Reuters ter visto soldados israelenses marcando casas com um “X” preto após seus ocupantes palestinos terem sido forçados a sair. Não ficou imediatamente claro o significado da marcação. O governo Netanyahu supervisionou uma rápida expansão dos assentamentos na Cisjordânia, considerados ilegais por órgãos da ONU e pela maioria dos países, embora Israel conteste essa avaliação. Em toda a Cisjordânia, Israel bloqueou as entradas da maioria das cidades e vilas palestinas, restringindo severamente a liberdade de movimento dos palestinos. Yousef Mur, morador da cidade palestina de Yatta, disse que os bloqueios o impediram de chegar a Jerusalém com sua filha para tratamento contra o câncer. “A situação é ruim e estamos sofrendo. Quando tentamos atravessar, eles lançaram granadas de efeito moral em nossa direção, e minha filha ficou assustada no caminho. Lançaram granadas de efeito moral contra as pessoas. A situação é muito difícil”, afirmou Mur. (Reportagem de Pesha Magid e Mussa Qawasma)

item.title: Irã intensifica esforços para atacar cidadãos dos EUA, alerta memorando de inteligência
item.description: O Irã intensificou os esforços para atingir cidadãos e funcionários dos Estados Unidos, e planos letais de Teerã contra norte-americanos chegaram a estágios “avançados”, alertou um alto funcionário de inteligência do governo Trump em um memorando obtido pela Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Enas Alashray
item.content:encoded: O Irã intensificou os esforços para atingir cidadãos e funcionários dos Estados Unidos, e planos letais de Teerã contra norte-americanos chegaram a estágios “avançados”, alertou um alto funcionário de inteligência do governo Trump em um memorando obtido pela Reuters. O alerta do diretor de Inteligência Nacional, Jay Clayton, foi emitido após Washington reduzir o quadro de funcionários de sua missão na Arábia Saudita nesta semana, em resposta à intensificação dos ataques das forças houthis aliadas do Irã. Esses ataques, em uma das frentes do conflito regional que já dura quase oito meses e foi desencadeado pela guerra envolvendo o Irã, coincidiram com um aumento dos ataques contra embarcações comerciais no Estreito de Hormuz. No início deste mês, fontes disseram à Reuters que o Irã estava preparando uma resposta mais contundente caso os Estados Unidos retomem ataques militares em larga escala contra seu território. “Especificamente, por vários canais, recebemos informações de inteligência de que o Irã aumentou substancialmente os esforços para atingir funcionários norte-americanos”, escreveu Clayton ao secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, em mensagem datada de 23 de outubro. “Os esforços iranianos para planejar ataques letais contra cidadãos dos EUA chegaram a estágios avançados tanto no Oriente Médio quanto em alguns outros países”, acrescentou. O diretor da CIA, John Ratcliffe, também recebeu cópia do memorando não confidencial, inicialmente divulgado pelo Axios. Na quarta-feira, o Departamento de Estado dos EUA determinou a retirada de funcionários governamentais não essenciais e de seus familiares das missões diplomáticas norte-americanas na Arábia Saudita e planejava retirar familiares de várias outras missões na região, disseram autoridades norte-americanas à Reuters. Neste sábado, o Departamento de Estado atualizou os alertas de viagem para mais de uma dezena de países do Golfo e do Oriente Médio, incluindo Arábia Saudita, Catar, Emirados Árabes Unidos, Iraque e Israel, citando o aumento da ameaça representada pelos houthis alinhados ao Irã. “Quando se trata do pessoal em nossas embaixadas, avaliamos constantemente novas informações sobre o ambiente de segurança”, disse uma autoridade dos EUA. “A ameaça de ataques dos houthis e de supostos complôs terroristas iranianos contra autoridades americanas está orientando nossas decisões sobre ajustes de pessoal em embaixadas que operam sob Status de Operações Restritas (RO Status) na região”, afirmou a autoridade. O Status de Operações Restritas dá ao Departamento de Estado maior flexibilidade para tomar decisões sobre pessoal sem precisar anunciar publicamente uma mudança na condição operacional de uma missão diplomática. A guerra envolvendo o Irã está a uma semana de entrar em seu nono mês e tem pressionado significativamente os índices de aprovação do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, às vésperas das eleições legislativas de meio de mandato, marcadas para 3 de novembro. (Reportagem de Enas Alashray e Humeyra Pamuk)

item.title: Fármaco de Amgen combinado con inmunoterapia prolonga supervivencia en ensayo clínico sobre cáncer de pulmón
item.description: El fármaco Imdelltra de Amgen, en combinación con Imfinzi de AstraZeneca , redujo el riesgo de muerte en un 58% en comparación con la inmunoterapia de AstraZeneca utilizado en monoterapia en pacientes con cáncer de pulmón microcítico en estadio extenso, según los datos de un estudio presentado el sábado.
item.dc:creator: Deena Beasley
item.content:encoded: El fármaco Imdelltra de Amgen, en combinación con Imfinzi de AstraZeneca (AZN.L) , redujo el riesgo de muerte en un 58% en comparación con la inmunoterapia de AstraZeneca utilizado en monoterapia en pacientes con cáncer de pulmón microcítico en estadio extenso, según los datos de un estudio presentado el sábado. Imfinzi es actualmente el tratamiento de referencia tras la quimioterapia para los pacientes con esta enfermedad tan agresiva y difícil de tratar, cuyo cáncer no empeora tras la quimioterapia inicial. El estudio reveló que los pacientes a los que se administraron ambos fármacos vivieron una mediana de 21,1 meses, frente a los 12,7 meses de los tratados únicamente con Imfinzi. "Si se administra Imdelltra antes, se obtiene un mayor beneficio clínico", afirmó Paul Burton, director médico de Amgen (AMGN.O) , quien calificó los resultados de "sin precedentes en el avance del tratamiento del cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas en estadio extenso". El fármaco de Amgen está actualmente autorizado para adultos en estadios avanzados de cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas que ha empeorado a pesar de la quimioterapia, basándose en datos que muestran que Imdelltra redujo el riesgo de muerte en un 40%. Los resultados completos del ensayo, en el que participaron 563 pacientes, se presentaron en el congreso de la Sociedad Europea de Oncología Médica en Madrid y se publicaron en la revista "New England Journal of Medicine". Amgen ya había anunciado anteriormente que el estudio de fase III había tenido éxito. Imdelltra pertenece a una clase de fármacos de doble diana denominados anticuerpos biespecíficos, diseñados para atraer a las células T del sistema inmunitario hacia las células cancerosas con el fin de destruirlas. Imfinzi es un tipo más antiguo de inmunoterapia que, básicamente, bloquea el mecanismo que utilizan los tumores para esconderse del ataque del sistema inmunitario. La mayoría de los casos de cáncer de pulmón son de células no pequeñas, mientras que hasta un 15% corresponde a la variedad de células pequeñas a la que se dirige Imdelltra. Muy pocas personas diagnosticadas con cáncer de pulmón de células pequeñas son candidatas a cirugía, y a la mayoría se les administra inicialmente radioterapia y quimioterapia, explicó Burton. Las tasas de supervivencia dependen del momento en que se diagnostica el cáncer, pero la tasa global a cinco años es solo de alrededor del 9%, según la Sociedad Americana contra el Cáncer. Amgen señaló que, mientras continúa el seguimiento de los pacientes, casi el 80% de los participantes en el ensayo tratados con la combinación seguían vivos al cabo de un año, frente al 53% de los que recibían solo Imfinzi. Se produjeron efectos secundarios graves, entre ellos un recuento bajo de glóbulos blancos, en el 20,9% de los pacientes que recibieron la terapia dual y en el 10,8% de los que recibieron la terapia en monoterapia. Se notificó una afección potencialmente peligrosa conocida como síndrome de liberación de citocinas —una respuesta inflamatoria agresiva— en el 49,6% de los pacientes que recibieron Imdelltra. Sin embargo, solo un caso fue grave y no se produjeron fallecimientos relacionados con ese síndrome.

item.title: Libya's Dbeibah says ready to address Egypt's maritime concerns
item.description: The prime minister of Libya's UN-recognised Government of National Unity told Egypt's intelligence chief his government was ready to address Cairo's concerns over Mediterranean maritime boundaries and economic waters, his office said on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The prime minister of Libya's UN-recognised Government of National Unity told Egypt's intelligence chief his government was ready to address Cairo's concerns over Mediterranean maritime boundaries and economic waters, his office said on Saturday. Prime Minister Abdulhamid Dbeibah and the intelligence chief Hassan Rashad discussed bilateral relations and coordination on matters of mutual interest during a phone call, the statement said Egypt rejected on Wednesday a maritime boundaries agreement ratified by Libya's eastern-based parliament involving Turkey, saying the deal was null and void and would have no legal effect on Egypt The Libya-Turkey maritime deal was [USN:KBN1Y21VL TEXT:"originally agreed"] in 2019 by Libya's internationally recognised government in Tripoli The rival eastern administration, under military commander Khalifa Haftar, withheld its approval for years The agreement is part of a long-running dispute over maritime claims and energy exploration rights in the eastern Mediterranean Greece, Egypt and Cyprus have opposed the Libya-Turkey accord, saying it infringes their own maritime claims Libya has been divided between Dbeibah's UN-recognised government in Tripoli and eastern authorities aligned with Haftar Egypt and Libya, which share a land border, have longstanding security and economic ties

item.title: Iran has ramped up efforts to target US personnel, intelligence memo warns
item.description: Iran has ramped up efforts to target US personnel, and lethal plots by Tehran against American citizens have reached "advanced stages", a senior intelligence official in the Trump administration warned in a memo seen by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Humeyra Pamuk, Enas Alashray
item.content:encoded: Iran has ramped up efforts to target US personnel, and lethal plots by Tehran against American citizens have reached "advanced stages", a senior intelligence official in the Trump administration warned in a memo seen by Reuters. The alert from Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton came after Washington scaled back staffing at its mission in Saudi Arabia earlier this week in response to intensified attacks by Iran-allied Houthi forces. Those attacks on one front of the nearly eight-month-old regional conflict triggered by the Iran war have coincided with [USN:L8N4682UH TEXT:"a rise in attacks"] on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. Earlier this month, sources told Reuters Iran was preparing a [USN:L8N45M1N4 TEXT:"more forceful response"] if the United States resumes large-scale military attacks on its territory. "Specifically, through various channels, we have received intelligence that Iran has substantially increased efforts to target US personnel," Clayton wrote to US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in a message dated October 23. "The lethal plotting efforts by the Iranians against US citizens have reached advanced stages in both the Middle East and certain other countries," he added. CIA Director John Ratcliffe was also copied in on the unclassified memo which was first reported by Axios. The State Department on Wednesday [USN:L6N46718Z TEXT:"ordered"] non-emergency government employees and their family members to leave US diplomatic missions in Saudi Arabia and planned to withdraw family members from a number of other missions in the region, US officials told Reuters. On Saturday, the US State Department updated travel advisories for more than a dozen countries across the Gulf and Middle East, including Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Iraq and Israel, citing an increased threat from Iran-aligned Houthis. "When it comes to our staffing at embassies, we constantly evaluate new information about the security environment," a US official said. "The threat of Houthi attacks and of Iranian terror plots targeting US officials are informing our decisions on staffing adjustments for embassies on RO Status in the region," the official said. The Restricted Operations Status provides the State Department more flexibility in personnel decisions without having to publicly announce a change in the status of a mission. The Iran war is a week away from entering its ninth month and has significantly weighed on the approval ratings of US President Donald Trump ahead of midterm elections on November 3.

item.title: Beier sends Dortmund top as Leipzig rout Elversberg
item.description: Maximilian Beier scored a superb winner as Borussia Dortmund went top of the Bundesliga with a 1-0 home victory over Eintracht Frankfurt on Saturday, while RB Leipzig swept aside promoted Elversberg 4-0 after a rampant second-half display.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Maximilian Beier scored a superb winner as Borussia Dortmund went top of the Bundesliga with a 1-0 home victory over Eintracht Frankfurt on Saturday, while RB Leipzig swept aside promoted Elversberg 4-0 after a rampant second-half display. Dortmund have 17 points from their seven matches, three points ahead of second-placed Bayern Munich, who have a game in hand and play on Sunday at Freiburg. The home side had been frustrated until Beier picked up the ball on the edge of the box, made space for the shot and curled his effort into the far corner of the net. The result ends a run of consecutive draws for Dortmund and is another clean sheet for a side who have conceded only four goals this season. CARDOSO DOUBLE Romulo Cardoso scored twice for RB Leipzig in their thumping win, while Tidiam Gomis and Christoph Baumgartner, in his first Bundesliga game of the season after injury, were also on target. Elversberg have acquitted themselves well in their maiden top-flight season but were well beaten. Werder Bremen climbed to sixth with a 3-2 victory at Mainz as a pair of Niclas Fuellkrug penalties inside the opening 25 minutes gave them the perfect start. Mainz pulled back a goal but Ludovit Reis made it 3-1 and despite the hosts netting again, Bremen were able to hold on for the win. Fuellkrug took his tally of goals this season to eight and leads the scorers' charts in the Bundesliga having scored in his last six league matches. Rayan Philippe netted a winning goal two minutes from the end as Paderborn moved out of the bottom three with a 1-0 win at home to Hamburg. Philippe joined Paderborn on loan from Hamburg this season and came off the bench against his parent club, choosing not to celebrate despite the enormity of the goal for his side. There was a goal and a red card each for Augsburg and Union Berlin as they drew 1-1. Both teams were down to 10 men before the first goal was scored as Felix Uduokhai got his marching orders for Union and Juma Bah was sent off for the home side. Han-Noah Massengo put the hosts ahead in the 71st minute but they had to settle for a point when Janik Haberer equalised for the visitors three minutes later. Cologne and Schalke played out a 0-0 draw, a result that left Schalke in the bottom three.

item.title: Belgian protesters and police skirmish at anti-government demonstrations in Brussels
item.description: The clashes were smaller than those that took place last week in Belgium and France.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Belgian police used tear gas and pepper spray as they clashed in Brussels on Saturday with anti-government demonstrators calling for better conditions in the education system, Reuters witnesses and Belgian media reported. The clashes came after hundreds of mainly young protesters gathered in a continuation of [USN:L6N46303L TEXT:"rallies"] that have taken place in recent months, calling for more funding for education and accusing police of excessive violence. The clashes were much smaller and less violent than those that took place last week in Belgium and — on a far larger scale — in [USN:L2N46A01A TEXT:"neighbouring France"]. In one incident in Brussels on Saturday, protesters ran and fell to the ground as police pursued them, with officers hitting and kicking one demonstrator, Reuters witnesses saw. Protesters threw road signs and other items onto a pile of rental scooters and bicycles and attempted to set it on fire. In another incident, police used tear gas to disperse a group of protesters, multiple Belgian media outlets reported. Brussels police said in a statement at the end of the afternoon that no major incidents had taken place. They said they had taken measures "to guarantee the maintenance of public order and the security of everyone". Police officers temporarily detained five people for disturbing public order and detained four more for possessing prohibited weapons and for inciting rioting, the statement said.

item.title: Accuser in Cornell rape allegations can stay anonymous, judge rules
item.description: The woman at the center of rape allegations against Cornell University students can keep using a pseudonym in her lawsuit, a judge ruled.
item.dc:creator: Milana Vinn
item.content:encoded: The woman at the center of rape allegations against Cornell University students can keep using a pseudonym in her lawsuit, a judge ruled. New York state Judge Phaedra Perry-Bond ruled on Friday that the accuser's privacy interests, particularly concerns for her safety, outweighed the need to publicly disclose her identity in court proceedings. The woman, who alleges she was drugged and raped by Cornell University students in 2024, has been the [USN:L6N45Q09V TEXT:"target of threats"], her lawyer, Thomas Giuffra, said earlier this month. Although the defendants in the lawsuit did not oppose the request for anonymity, Perry-Bond wrote that "some members of the public have made it their mission to try and identify Jane Doe." The judge warned that "cyberstalking and engaging in or encouraging threats across state lines, whether it be of Jane Doe, of any of the named defendants, or their attorneys, can be considered a federal crime and perpetrators of those acts may be subjecting themselves to prosecution." The woman, who was 20 at the time of the alleged gang rape, filed her suit on September 16, prompting prosecutors to reopen a criminal investigation they had initially closed without charges.

item.title: Report: Indiana RB Khobie Martin to return vs. Michigan
item.description: Indiana running back Khobie Martin is expected to return from a six-game absence and play against Michigan on Saturday afternoon, ESPN reported.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Indiana running back Khobie Martin is expected to return from a six-game absence and play against Michigan on Saturday afternoon, ESPN reported. Martin has been sidelined since sustaining a broken forearm in the Hoosiers' season-opening 52-16 victory over North Texas on Sept. 5. The junior did not record a carry in the game. Martin rushed 78 times for 505 yards (6.5-yard average) and six touchdowns in 14 games as Indiana marched to an undefeated national championship season in 2025. Turbo Richards leads Indiana (6-1, 3-1) this season with a Big Ten-best 643 rushing yards and six touchdowns. Lee Beebe Jr. has 575 yards and four scores on the ground. Michigan (4-2, 1-2) and sixth-ranked Indiana are meeting in Ann Arbor, Mich. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ex-NBA G Malik Beasley negotiating plea in gambling case
item.description: Malik Beasley's attorney says the former NBA guard is working on a plea deal in his federal betting and bribery case.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Malik Beasley's attorney says the former NBA guard is working on a plea deal in his federal betting and bribery case. Attorney Steve Haney told ESPN on Saturday that Beasley, 29, is negotiating with Department of Justice prosecutors and a decision is expected early next week. A recent notice posted on the court docket indicated that he intends to plead guilty, according to ESPN. The U.S. Attorney's Office in the Eastern District of New York alleges that Beasley deliberately manipulated his statistics in at least four games to benefit gamblers while he was playing for the Milwaukee Bucks in 2023-24. Beasley, who played for six teams in nine seasons in the NBA from 2016-25, was indicted on federal charges in June. He initially pleaded not guilty to all counts of bribery in sporting contests, wire fraud conspiracy, honest services wire fraud conspiracy and money laundering conspiracy. The indictment alleges that Beasley lost millions of dollars gambling during his career and agreed to adjust his performance so his alleged co-conspirators could wager on his statistics. Beasley, a first-round pick in the 2016 NBA Draft by Denver, earned nearly $60 million in his NBA career. He averaged 11.7 points in 578 games with the Nuggets, Minnesota Timberwolves, Utah Jazz, Los Angeles Lakers, Bucks and Detroit Pistons. Former NBA player Ed Davis also was charged in the case and has pleaded not guilty. --Field Level Media

item.title: Ataques ucranianos dejan sin electricidad a Crimea y a las zonas controladas por Rusia: Moscú
item.description: Ataques ucranianos provocaron el sábado cortes de electricidad en algunas zonas de Crimea y en las áreas del este y el sur de Ucrania controladas por Rusia, informó el Ministerio de Energía ruso.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Ataques ucranianos provocaron el sábado cortes de electricidad en algunas zonas de Crimea y en las áreas del este y el sur de Ucrania controladas por Rusia, informó el Ministerio de Energía ruso. Los ataques afectaron la infraestructura energética, lo que provocó cortes en algunas zonas de las regiones de Jersón, Zaporiyia, Donetsk y Lugansk, añadió. El ministerio no precisó cuántas personas se habían visto afectadas en esas zonas y en la península de Crimea, que fue anexionada por Rusia en 2014. El personal estaba trabajando para restablecer los servicios y se habían realizado cortes temporales de electricidad para mantener la estabilidad de la red, añadió.

item.title: China insta a EEUU a que frene ampliación propuesta de restricciones a la inversión en el extranjero
item.description: El Ministerio de Comercio chino instó el sábado a Estados Unidos a que dejara de ampliar las restricciones a las inversiones en China, alegando que una norma propuesta sobre tecnologías sensibles perturbaría las relaciones comerciales.
item.dc:creator: Eduardo Baptista
item.content:encoded: El Ministerio de Comercio chino instó el sábado a Estados Unidos a que dejara de ampliar las restricciones a las inversiones en China, alegando que una norma propuesta sobre tecnologías sensibles perturbaría las relaciones comerciales. El Departamento del Tesoro publicó el jueves una serie de propuestas para actualizar su programa de seguridad en materia de inversiones en el extranjero, añadiendo la biotecnología a los sectores restringidos y ampliando el alcance de la normativa a la informática de alto rendimiento y los sistemas hipersónicos. El Ministerio de Comercio de Pekín afirmó en un comunicado que la propuesta amplía "de forma discriminatoria" las restricciones a las inversiones relacionadas con China e intensifica las limitaciones, añadiendo que se opone firmemente a la propuesta estadounidense y se reserva el derecho a adoptar contramedidas que no especificó. Pekín también señaló que la propuesta dañaría las relaciones económicas bilaterales y era contraria al consenso alcanzado por los presidentes de ambos países, que se han reunido en dos ocasiones en los últimos seis meses. El Tesoro ha declarado que las medidas, que no se limitan a China, buscan impedir que el capital estadounidense financie el desarrollo, por parte de adversarios extranjeros, de tecnologías estratégicas de doble uso que podrían amenazar la seguridad nacional. El programa ya había restringido determinadas inversiones estadounidenses relacionadas con China en los ámbitos de los semiconductores, las tecnologías cuánticas y la inteligencia artificial.

item.title: Trump afirma que podría trasladar a la prensa acreditada en la Casa Blanca
item.description: El presidente Donald Trump confirmó el sábado que podría trasladar a la prensa acreditada en la Casa Blanca a otra ubicación.
item.dc:creator: Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: El presidente Donald Trump confirmó el sábado que podría trasladar a la prensa acreditada en la Casa Blanca a otra ubicación. En una publicación en las redes sociales, Trump desmintió un reporte que señalaba que tenía previsto eliminar la sala de prensa de la Casa Blanca y restaurar una piscina histórica en ese mismo lugar, afirmando que nunca se le había "pasado por la cabeza hacer algo tan estúpido". Sin embargo, señaló que podría reubicar al cuerpo de prensa de su ubicación actual en la Casa Blanca. "Quizá traslade a los de las noticias falsas a un lugar menos molesto", afirmó Trump. El New York Times informó el martes que Trump había instado en agosto a la entonces secretaria de prensa Karoline Leavitt a trasladar las ruedas de prensa fuera de la sala de prensa James S. Brady de la Casa Blanca, aunque la idea nunca se llevó a cabo. Según el reporte, el presidente dijo a sus asesores que preferiría disponer de una piscina terapéutica cubierta que se instaló en ese lugar durante la administración de Franklin D. Roosevelt. El Gobierno de Richard Nixon sustituyó la piscina por la sala de prensa. Trump ha acusado con frecuencia a la prensa estadounidenses de informar de forma sesgada sobre su Gobierno. Trump prohibió temporalmente el mes pasado el acceso a los terrenos de la Casa Blanca a periodistas de CNN, MS NOW y Politico, y afirmó que otros medios podrían enfrentarse a restricciones similares. La Casa Blanca restableció su acceso tras una orden de un juez federal que consideró que la medida era probablemente inconstitucional, aunque el Gobierno sigue impugnando el caso.

item.description: El senador brasileño Flávio Bolsonaro y el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva siguen prácticamente empatados de cara a la segunda vuelta electoral del domingo, reveló el sábado una encuesta de CNT/MDA.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El senador brasileño Flávio Bolsonaro y el presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva siguen prácticamente empatados de cara a la segunda vuelta electoral del domingo, reveló el sábado una encuesta de CNT/MDA. El senador de derecha, hijo mayor del expresidente Jair Bolsonaro, obtendría el 46,3% de los votos, frente al 45% de Lula, según la encuesta. La semana pasada, otro sondeo mostraba a Bolsonaro por delante de Lula con un 46,8% frente a un 45,9%. MDA encuestó a 2.032 personas entre el 21 y el 23 de octubre. El margen de error es de +/-2,2 puntos porcentuales.

item.title: After 'everything went wrong,' Suns eager to make right vs. Warriors
item.description: The Suns and Golden State Warriors -- two teams in various stages of recovery -- will meet in Phoenix on Saturday, when one will break into the win column.
item.dc:creator: Field Level Media
item.content:encoded: The Suns and Golden State Warriors -- two teams in various stages of recovery -- will meet in Phoenix on Saturday, when one will break into the win column. The Warriors collapsed late in a 111-108 loss to Memphis in their home opener Friday, giving up 17 straight points after De'Anthony Melton's 3-pointer gave them a 106-94 edge with 3:47 left. "Everything went wrong," guard Stephen Curry said after the Warriors fell to 0-2 for the first time since 2020-21. The Suns hit a similar roadblock in Portland on Wednesday, when they gave up the first 21 points in a 124-83 loss in the Trail Blazers' home opener. "We just absolutely got blitzed," Suns coach Jordan Ott said. Curry scored 24 points against the Grizzlies after finishing with 23 in a 127-105 loss at the Los Angeles Lakers on Wednesday. But he has yet to find his range, going 12-of-30 from the field and 5-of-17 from 3-point range. Before the Memphis game, Warriors coach Steve Kerr outlined a new substitution pattern for Curry as the team seeks to offset the loss of scoring big man Kristaps Porzingis (undisclosed health issue) for the foreseeable future. "He'll play the first seven or eight minutes in the first quarter and then come back at the top of the second for a shorter shift," Kerr said of Curry. "That's how we are starting this year, and we'll see how it goes. It's always flexible." Curry played the first seven minutes of the first quarter Friday and played another seven, including the first 3 1/2 in the second quarter. He had 14 of his points in 15 second-half minutes. The Suns, who eliminated the Warriors in the play-in round 111-96 on April 17, found no rhythm on either side of the ball in Portland. They trailed by as many as 52 points in that game. They shot 35.7% from the field and were outrebounded 56-39. The Trail Blazers made 19 of 47 3-pointers and were in the penalty before the Suns made a field goal. Devin Booker scored 23 points on 7-of-13 shooting, but Dillon Brooks, Jalen Green and newcomer Miles Bridges were a combined 11-of-34 from the floor. The Blazers led 43-12 after the first quarter. "Everything went wrong," Booker said, echoing Curry. "We have a lot to learn from on tape. They were killing us with their pace. It's an uphill battle when you are down 30 points. You feel like every shot has to go in. We just have to get off to a better start." Suns second-year center Khaman Maluach started Wednesday, although both Maluach and third-year player Oso Ighodaro likely are to share post minutes while Mark Williams (left shoulder) is out. Maluach had two points and six rebounds in 17 minutes. "Throwing young guys into the fire ... that's what you see, and he'll learn from this," Ott said. "We need him. We need him to grow. He will continue to grow. We need him to take a step. He'll take steps." Ighodaro left the Portland game in the first half with an apparent right hip injury and did not return. Off guard Luke Kennard (left knee) did not play against the Blazers. The status of each player for Saturday's game is unknown. Warriors guard Brandin Podziemski and rookie Yaxel Lendeborg had 18 points against Memphis. Backup big man Charles Bassey (knee) missed his second straight game. --Field Level Media

item.title: Na véspera do 2º turno, Lula diz que povo assumiu responsabilidade por campanha
item.description: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) disse neste sábado que o povo assumiu a responsabilidade por sua campanha no segundo turno da eleição presidencial, marcado para o domingo, e mostrou convicção de que conquistará um quarto mandato presidencial quando a apuração dos votos for realizada.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) disse neste sábado que o povo assumiu a responsabilidade por sua campanha no segundo turno da eleição presidencial, marcado para o domingo, e mostrou convicção de que conquistará um quarto mandato presidencial quando a apuração dos votos for realizada. Em declaração à imprensa antes de participar de evento de campanha em Copacabana, acompanhado por uma multidão, Lula também fez críticas ao senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), seu adversário, que terminou à frente no primeiro turno, realizado no dia 4 de outubro. "Estou dizendo para vocês e podem anotar, amanhã eu serei eleito presidente da República outra vez", afirmou Lula aos jornalistas. "O povo assumiu para si a responsabilidade de fazer a campanha. Hoje nós temos um exército de democratas neste país maior que o Exército chinês, maior que o Exército russo e maior que o Exército americano que é o Exército do Lula, que vai chegar a 13 milhões de soldados e soldadas amanhã", continuou. "E vamos ganhar as eleições por uma simples razão: é verdade que o povo quer mudança, e o povo quer mudança para melhor, o povo quer mudança para frente. O povo não quer retroceder e não está longe da nossa memória o que aconteceu no mandato dessa gente nesse país", acrescentou. Lula se referia ao canal de WhatsApp Exército do Lula, criado pelo deputado federal reeleito André Janones (Rede-MG), no qual o parlamentar passa a apoiadores "missões" para colocar Lula em destaque nas redes sociais e para fazer críticas a Flávio. A fala de Lula sobre a participação popular no segundo turno da campanha vem depois de uma série de críticas à campanha petista no primeiro turno, de dentro e de fora do PT e inclusive do próprio Lula, que em reunião logo após a primeira rodada disse que a campanha até o dia 4 de outubro foi a [USN:L6N45T151 TEXT:""menos organizada""] de que participou desde 1989. Após a passeata em Copacabana, Lula fará à tarde evento de campanha na Avenida Paulista, em São Paulo. No domingo, a previsão é que vote logo cedo pela manhã em São Bernardo do Campo e acompanhe a apuração na capital paulista. Flávio venceu o primeiro turno com 47,03% dos votos válidos contra 45,16% de Lula. As pesquisas de intenção de voto têm mostrado empate técnico entre ambos, com vantagem numérica para o senador. Levantamento [USN:S0N46101Q TEXT:"CNT/MDA"] divulgado neste sábado mostrou Flávio com 46,3% dos votos totais contra 45% de Lula. Nos votos válidos, quando são excluídos brancos, nulos e indecisos, o senador tem 50,7% e o presidente soma 49,3%.

item.title: WTA roundup: No. 1 Elena Rybakina chasing 4th title of '26
item.description: World No. 1 Elena Rybakina will play for her fourth title of the season Sunday at the Ningbo Open in China, opposing Canada's Leylah Fernandez.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: World No. 1 Elena Rybakina will play for her fourth title of the season Sunday at the Ningbo Open in China, opposing Canada's Leylah Fernandez. Both players posted 6-3, 7-5 victories on Saturday. Top-seeded Rybakina, from Kazakhstan, beat No. 6 Diana Shnaider of Russia and Fernandez topped Czech Marie Bouzkova. Rybakina, who won the WTA 500 tournament last year, is seeking the first successful title defense of her career and her 15th career title. Fernandez has six career titles, winning in Singapore in September. Rybakina holds a 3-2 lead in their head-to-head series. Japan Open Ashlyn Krueger defeated fellow American and No. 1 seed Ann Li 6-4, 6-7 (4), 6-3 to earn a place in the finals in Osaka. Li lost serve in the first game of the third set and could not catch up. Serving down 5-3 in the third, Li went up 40-0 and squandered the lead, with Krueger winning on her second match point. Krueger won the title in Osaka in 2023 and is 10-2 in her career at the WTA 250 tournament. She will face Czech Katerina Siniakova, who defeated No. 8 Katie Boulter of Great Britain 6-1, 6-4 in the other semifinal. --Field Level Media

item.title: Azul anuncia financiamento de até R$2 bi para combustível de aviação
item.description: A Azul firmou uma operação de financiamento de até R$2 bilhões, com cobertura do risco de crédito concedida pela União, por intermédio da Agência Brasileira Gestora de Fundos Garantidores e Garantias (ABGF), com recursos do Fundo de Garantia à Exportação (FGE), conforme fato relevante da companhia aérea publicado neste sábado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A Azul (AZUL3.SA) firmou uma operação de financiamento de até R$2 bilhões, com cobertura do risco de crédito concedida pela União, por intermédio da Agência Brasileira Gestora de Fundos Garantidores e Garantias (ABGF), com recursos do Fundo de Garantia à Exportação (FGE), conforme fato relevante da companhia aérea publicado neste sábado. "Os recursos serão destinados exclusivamente ao pagamento de combustível de aviação adquirido para operação regular doméstica", informou a empresa, acrescentando que o financiamento está alinhado à estratégia de longo prazo da companhia e foi contemplado como parte de seu plano de reestruturação. "A operação fortalece ainda mais a posição de liquidez da Azul e proporciona flexibilidade financeira adicional para atuar no atual cenário de volatilidade nos preços dos combustíveis. Somado ao caixa existente e a outras iniciativas de financiamento obtidas recentemente, o montante reforça a confiança da administração na estratégia da companhia e na posição de liquidez da Azul", acrescentou.

item.title: Trump diz que pode mudar equipe de imprensa da Casa Branca de lugar
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, confirmou neste sábado que pode transferir a equipe de jornalistas da Casa Branca para outro local.
item.dc:creator: Jason Lange
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, confirmou neste sábado que pode transferir a equipe de jornalistas da Casa Branca para outro local. Em uma publicação nas redes sociais, Trump rejeitou uma reportagem segundo a qual ele planejava remover a sala de imprensa da Casa Branca e restaurar, no local, uma piscina histórica. Ele disse que nunca “sequer pensou em fazer uma coisa tão estúpida”. No entanto, afirmou que poderia realocar o grupo de jornalistas de sua posição atual na Casa Branca. “Posso mudar a Fake News para um local menos desagradável”, escreveu Trump na publicação. O jornal The New York Times informou na terça-feira que Trump havia pedido à então secretária de imprensa Karoline Leavitt, em agosto, que transferisse as entrevistas coletivas para fora da Sala de Imprensa James S. Brady, na Casa Branca, mas a ideia nunca foi colocada em prática. Segundo a reportagem, o presidente disse a assessores que preferiria uma piscina terapêutica coberta, instalada no local durante o governo de Franklin D. Roosevelt. A administração de Nixon substituiu a piscina pela sala de imprensa. Trump tem acusado regularmente a mídia norte-americana de cobertura injusta de seu governo. No mês passado, ele baniu brevemente jornalistas da CNN, da MS NOW e do Politico das dependências da Casa Branca e disse que outros veículos poderiam enfrentar restrições semelhantes. Defensores da liberdade de expressão afirmaram que a medida violou as proteções da Primeira Emenda à liberdade de imprensa. A Casa Branca restabeleceu o acesso desses jornalistas após uma ordem de um juiz federal, que considerou o banimento provavelmente inconstitucional, embora o governo Trump ainda conteste o caso. (Reportagem de Jason Lange em Washington)

item.title: Amgen drug combined with immunotherapy extends survival in lung cancer trial
item.description: Amgen's Imdelltra used in combination with AstraZeneca's immunotherapy Imfinzi reduced the risk of death by 58% compared to the Astra drug alone in patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, according to data from a study presented at a major medical meeting on Saturday.
item.dc:creator: Deena Beasley
item.content:encoded: Amgen's (AMGN.O) Imdelltra used in combination with AstraZeneca's (AZN.L) immunotherapy Imfinzi reduced the risk of death by 58% compared to the Astra drug alone in patients with extensive-stage small cell lung cancer, according to data from a study presented at a major medical meeting on Saturday. Imfinzi is currently the standard of care following chemotherapy for patients with this very aggressive and hard-to-treat disease whose cancer does not worsen after initial chemotherapy. The study found that those given both drugs lived for a median of 21.1 months, compared with 12.7 months for those treated only with Imfinzi. "If you give Imdelltra earlier and earlier, you get bigger clinical benefit," said Paul Burton, chief medical officer at California-based Amgen. He called the results "unprecedented in advancing the treatment of extensive-stage small cell lung cancer." Imdelltra's US list price is about $30,000 per cycle, or over $390,000 a year. Wall Street analysts have estimated annual sales reaching more than $2.5 billion by 2030, according to LSEG data. The Amgen drug is currently [USN:L4N3HJ4BN TEXT:"approved for adults"] in the advanced stages of small cell lung cancer that has worsened despite chemotherapy, based on data showing that Imdelltra reduced the risk of death by [USN:L2N3S10O8 TEXT:"40%"]. Full results of the 563-patient trial were presented at the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting in Madrid and published in the New England Journal of Medicine. Amgen had previously announced that the Phase 3 study was [USN:L6N4500PD TEXT:"successful"]. Imdelltra belongs to a dual-target class of drugs called bispecific antibodies designed to pull immune system T cells into contact with cancer cells to destroy them. Imfinzi is an older type of immunotherapy that essentially blocks the mechanism tumors use to hide from immune-system assault. Most lung cancer cases are non-small cell, while up to 15% are the small cell variety targeted by Imdelltra. About 250,000 new cases are diagnosed worldwide each year, according to the US National Institutes of Health. Very few people diagnosed with small cell lung cancer are candidates for surgery, and most are initially given radiotherapy and chemotherapy, Burton said. Survival rates depend on when the cancer is diagnosed, but the overall 5-year rate is only around 9%, according to the American Cancer Society. Amgen said that nearly 80% of trial patients treated with the combination were alive after one year, compared with 53% of those on Imfinzi alone, as patient follow-up continues. Serious side effects, including low white blood cell counts, occurred in 20.9% of patients on the dual therapy and 10.8% with the single therapy. A potentially dangerous condition known as cytokine release syndrome, an aggressive inflammatory response, was reported in 49.6% of patients who received Imdelltra. But only one case was serious and there were no CRS-related deaths. Adverse events led to discontinuation of the combination therapy in 5.7% of trial patients and 5.8% of patients given only Imfinzi. (This story has been corrected to say that median survival for trial patients is 21.1 months vs. 12.7 months, not 21.7 months vs. 12.1 months, in first bullet point.)

item.title: Rei da Jordânia ordena resposta com "mão de ferro" a ataque mortal à igreja
item.description: O rei Abdullah da Jordânia ordenou neste sábado que as forças de segurança respondessem com “mão de ferro”, enquanto as autoridades procuravam os atiradores que mataram nove pessoas durante um funeral em uma igreja.
item.dc:creator: Abdelhadi Ramahi
item.content:encoded: O rei Abdullah da Jordânia ordenou neste sábado que as forças de segurança respondessem com “mão de ferro”, enquanto as autoridades procuravam os atiradores que mataram nove pessoas durante um funeral em uma igreja. Os agressores dispararam por vários minutos, em plena luz do dia, contra a igreja na província de Karak na sexta-feira, e também feriram 40 pessoas em um ataque raro contra a minoria cristã do país. A segurança foi reforçada em shoppings, embaixadas estrangeiras e outros locais em todo o país, informou a embaixada dos Estados Unidos em Amã. SENSAÇÃO DE PÂNICO Um padre descreveu como ele e outras pessoas mandaram que todos se deitassem no chão na igreja Greco-Ortodoxa São Jorge, a cerca de 120 km a sudoeste da capital, Amã. “Uma sensação de pânico tomou conta das pessoas presentes”, disse Theodoros Soueiss à Reuters. “Os disparos eram indiscriminados, e você nunca sabia onde uma bala poderia parar.” O rei Abdullah condenou o “desprezível ato terrorista” durante uma reunião do Conselho de Segurança Nacional e afirmou que não há espaço para clemência quando se trata da vida dos jordanianos, informou a corte real. Ataques como este são extremamente raros na Jordânia, um país relativamente estável no Oriente Médio, embora as autoridades afirmem ter frustrado vários complôs islamistas nos últimos anos. Não houve reivindicação imediata de responsabilidade pelo ataque no reino, um importante parceiro dos EUA na luta contra grupos militantes. Autoridades disseram ser cedo para determinar se os atacantes tinham vínculos com grupos conhecidos dentro ou fora da Jordânia. “Um massacre, um massacre em todos os sentidos da palavra”, disse Tarek Ammarin em um hospital onde os feridos estavam sendo atendidos. Um parente de Ammarin ficou ferido no ataque. Os cristãos são minoria na população da Jordânia. O país abriga diversos sítios bíblicos que atraem peregrinos cristãos de todo o mundo. A Jordânia está entre os aliados dos EUA no Oriente Médio que foram atingidos por ataques iranianos este ano, após os EUA e Israel lançarem ataques contra o Irã em fevereiro. Bahjat al-Rushda, prefeito da vila de Shihan, em Karak, juntou-se a uma longa lista de autoridades que condenaram o que chamaram de ataque de extremistas terroristas. “Se Deus quiser, este país continuará seguro”, disse ele. (Reportagem de Yasmine Ghania e Eman Abouhassira)

item.title: City boss Maresca rues costly errors as Villa inflict first league defeat
item.description: Manchester City's perfect start to the Premier League season came to an abrupt end at Villa Park on Saturday when two costly mistakes condemned Enzo Maresca's side to a 2-1 defeat despite them dominating large stretches of the contest.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Manchester City's perfect start to the Premier League season came to an abrupt end at Villa Park on Saturday when two costly mistakes condemned Enzo Maresca's side to a 2-1 defeat despite them dominating large stretches of the contest. City arrived in Birmingham having won all seven of their league matches but a pair of defensive blunders gave Aston Villa their chances and they took both. Marc Guehi's early miscontrol allowed John McGinn to set up Nicolas Jackson for the opening goal, while goalkeeper Gianluigi Donnarumma allowed Jackson's low shot to squirm underneath him after the hour mark. The result was particularly frustrating for City given the balance of play. They registered seven shots on target to Villa's two and repeatedly forced Zion Suzuki into action, but the Japan goalkeeper produced a string of excellent saves to preserve the hosts' lead. There was at least one positive for City with Erling Haaland scoring on his return from a foot injury. The Norwegian had sat out Tuesday's 5-1 Champions League rout of AEK Athens but headed home from Iliman Ndiaye's cross for City's lone goal. The afternoon belonged instead to Suzuki, who continued to justify Villa's faith since they signed him in August to replace the departed Emi Martinez. Time and again he denied City, frustrating Haaland and company as Villa claimed their fourth successive home league victory over the Blues.
